question: Should CodexBar permanently expose editable per-provider confetti palettes, or should this change stop at automatic provider-specific defaults?
rationale: Both implementations are technically feasible, but the choice determines lasting provider-settings complexity, persisted preference surface, localization burden, and maintenance expectations.

options.title: Ship defaults only
options.body: Keep curated provider-specific palettes and remove the editor and persisted override setting for a smaller, maintenance-friendly feature.

options.title: Ship full customization
options.body: Accept the editor and persisted overrides after end-to-end proof covers editing, invalid drafts, relaunch persistence, reset, and resulting confetti.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave the existing randomized celebration unchanged if provider branding and customization are not worth the ongoing descriptor and settings maintenance.

recommendation.title: Ship defaults only
recommendation.body: Keep curated provider-specific palettes and remove the editor and persisted override setting for a smaller, maintenance-friendly feature.

likelyOwner.reason: The original confetti feature was merged through this owner’s commit, making them the clearest history-backed decision route.
